entries.proposition: The review states the model: pY33-WWOX is proapoptotic and anticancer and maintains normal physiology, while pS14-WWOX accumulates in cancer and Alzheimer lesions, and that Zfra suppression of S14 phosphorylation abolishes cancer growth and retards AD progression.
entries.snippet: Under pathological conditions, proapoptotic pY33-WWOX is downregulated and shifted to pS14-WWOX. pS14-WWOX is accumulated in the lesions of cancer and AD brains
